# Vendored `rapidhash.h`

`src/rapidhash.h` is a **verbatim vendored copy** of rapidhash V3 by Nicolas De Carli
([Nicoshev/rapidhash](https://github.com/Nicoshev/rapidhash)), MIT licensed, carried in
via upstream box3d `30c67b5` ("Fixed the 64-bit hash function and added unit test").

    Vendored bytes: sha256 337258afbe3e6254ef684f1fcf1df87b2e7d957351794f5d06da7d242dd6e2d8

## Do not edit this file, and do not casually update it

It backs `b3Hash64NonZero`, which is the content hash of every `b3HullData`,
`b3MeshData` and `b3HeightFieldData` in the engine. **Changing a single byte of it
changes every geometry hash**, which changes geometry dedup keys and invalidates the
content hashes baked into existing recordings.

So the guard here is deliberately the *opposite* of the one on `extern/fixed`. That
directory is generated and CI checks it still **matches** its upstream pin, because
drifting away from upstream is the failure. Here, silently **following** upstream is
the failure: a newer rapidhash that is faster and better in every way is still a
different function, and adopting it is a decision with a recording-format consequence,
never a routine refresh.

`.github/workflows/vendor-drift.yml` therefore checks only that the bytes on disk still
hash to the digest above. It is a tripwire against an accidental hand edit to a file
that looks like ordinary third-party code and is actually load-bearing on determinism.

## If the hash function ever does need to change

It is a `B3_REC_VERSION_MAJOR` bump, the same as the 64-bit widening was (major 6).
Re-measure the determinism goldens afterwards — note that in this tree
`b3HashWorldState` covers only body transforms and velocities, not geometry hash bytes,
so a pure hash-function swap is expected to leave them untouched; verify rather than
assume, because that property is a fact about `recording.c` and not a law.

## Determinism properties, checked rather than assumed

- **No floating point.** `grep -n 'float\|double' src/rapidhash.h` returns nothing.
- **Byte order is normalized.** Big-endian builds byte-swap every read
  (`rapid_read64`/`rapid_read32`), so the digest is platform independent.
- **The compile-time variants that change the value are not reachable.**
  `RAPIDHASH_PROTECTED` would alter the mixer and is never defined; the default is
  `RAPIDHASH_FAST`. `RAPIDHASH_COMPACT` (the default) and `RAPIDHASH_UNROLLED` are
  value-identical — the unrolled loop is two compact iterations.
- **The 128-bit multiply paths agree.** `__uint128_t`, `_umul128`/`__umulh` and the
  32x32 fallback all compute the same full product.

`test/test_hash.c` is the behavioural check: 13 subtests over word families, a full bit
sweep, zero-length blobs, Q48.16 sign and one-quantum perturbations, and the real baked
hull / mesh / height-field / voxel corpora.
